HERO.TITLE: A century of music and tradition
HERO.SUBTITLE: The town band of Casali del Manco: passion, community and band culture growing year after year.

ASSOCIAZIONE.TITLE: Our association
ASSOCIAZIONE.TEXT: We are a non-profit association promoting musical band culture and tradition in the area through initiatives, concerts, and social activities. Our goals are safeguarding historical-cultural roots, spreading band culture, and building a sense of community.

SEDE.TITLE: Headquarters
SEDE.TEXT: Our location: Via traversa campanile 31, Casali del Manco (CS) loc. Pedace. A meeting place where we rehearse, run our music school, and gather for future planning. Here, repertoires, friendships, and projects are built.

STORIA.TITLE: Our history
STORIA.TEXT: A tradition stretching over a century. Our origins lie in the former musical band of Pedace, with the first records going back to 1925. In 2019, with the merging of Pedace and four other towns into the municipality of Casali del Manco, the band also changed its name. We grow year after year through events and concerts, holding many great projects for the future.

BANDA.TITLE: The marching band
BANDA.TEXT: An ensemble uniting the experience of the older members with the fresh energy of the youth. We rely on expert soloists, trained professionals, and conservatory students. We work on band repertoires, soundtracks, arrangements, and classics. The band's conductor is currently Franco Guglielmelli, assisted by Pietro Rizzo.

SCUOLA.TITLE: The music school
SCUOLA.TEXT: We offer training courses, providing new members with the method and fundamentals of music theory, solfeggio, and instrument playing. A journey to approach instruments and grow musically, together. The courses are held by: Pietro Rizzo, Gianmarco Scrivano, Daniela D'Ambrosio, and Mario Zicarelli.

DIRETTIVO.TITLE: The board of directors
DIRETTIVO.TEXT: The board is the association's body responsible for making decisions and charting the course for the future. A group coordinating activities, events, and projects transparently and on behalf of all members. The association's president is currently Aurelio Marotta.

EVENT_CTA.TITLE: An event, a festivity or a concert on request?
EVENT_CTA.DESC: We can bring the band to patron saint festivals, anniversaries and commissioned concerts: tell us your idea and let's make it happen together.

ABOUT.HEADER_DESC: The “Città di Casali del Manco” town band promotes musical culture and participation. Every rehearsal and every concert is a concrete way to build community and bonds.
ABOUT.SEC_STORIA_TEXT: The “Città di Casali del Manco” town band was born from the will to preserve and grow a local tradition. Over time it has become a cultural landmark: a place where music unites generations, creates friendships and builds community.
ABOUT.SEC_OGGI_TEXT: Today the band is a lively and growing group: rehearsals, study and carefully curated repertoires. We perform band music, modern arrangements, soundtracks and classics, always seeking a balance between quality and participation.
ABOUT.SEC_SCUOLA_TEXT: The music school is our investment in the future: a path to introduce children, teenagers and adults to studying an instrument, step by step and with clear goals. This is where passion — and the band's continuity — begins.
ABOUT.FINAL_TITLE: Want to play with us or join the school?
ABOUT.FINAL_DESC: Write to us: we'll reply with information about rehearsals, enrolment and activities.

ABOUT_TODAY.HEADER_TITLE: A living group, a shared sound
ABOUT_TODAY.HEADER_DESC: The “Città di Casali del Manco” town band is an active community bringing together musicians of different generations. Weekly rehearsals, concerts, processions: a steady commitment to bring music and tradition to the area.
ABOUT_TODAY.HERO_CAPTION: The full band during a recent concert
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_ORGANICO_TEXT: The band today counts around 30-40 active members among winds (woodwinds and brass) and percussion. The lineup varies by performance: from smaller formations for processions and ceremonies, up to the full ensemble for concerts in the square or special events.
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_REPERTORIO_TEXT: The repertoire ranges from Italian band tradition (marches, opera symphonies, concert pieces) to soundtracks, pop music arranged for band, and modern compositions. New pieces are added every year to keep interest and musical growth alive.
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_PROVE_TEXT: Rehearsals are held weekly at the band's headquarters. During preparation for concerts or events, rehearsals may become more frequent. Besides ensemble rehearsals, there are dedicated study sessions by section (woodwinds, brass, percussion).
ABOUT_TODAY.SEC_DIREZIONE_TEXT: The artistic direction guides the band's musical path: choosing the repertoire, preparing concerts, coordinating with the music school. The conductor works closely with section leaders to ensure quality and cohesion.
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_CONCERTI_DESC: Performances in squares, theatres and public venues across the area
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_PROCESSIONI_DESC: Musical accompaniment for patron saint festivals and religious occasions
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_CERIMONIE_DESC: Participation in civil events, commemorations and celebrations
ABOUT_TODAY.ACT_COLLAB_DESC: Projects with other musical groups, schools and associations
ABOUT_TODAY.JOIN_DESC: If you already play a wind or percussion instrument, you can become part of our group. Onboarding is gradual: you'll first take part in rehearsals and then, when ready, in performances.
ABOUT_TODAY.REQ_1: Able to read music (even at a basic level)
ABOUT_TODAY.REQ_2: Own a wind or percussion instrument

ABOUT_SCHOOL.HEADER_DESC: The band's music school offers a complete training path: from reading music to instrumental technique, all the way to the experience of playing together. A welcoming environment to learn, grow and share a passion for music.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.INTRO_P1: The band's music school isn't just a place to learn to play: it's a learning journey that guides the student from the very first note all the way to joining the band's lineup. The method is based on a gradual approach, with attention to music theory, instrumental technique and, above all, ensemble practice.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.INTRO_P2: The teachers are experienced musicians, often active members of the band itself, who pass on not only technical skills but also a passion for music and a sense of belonging to a community.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVELS_DESC: Three progressive levels to guide each student along their musical journey.
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_BASE_ITEM_1: Introduction to reading music (notes, rhythms, time)
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_BASE_ITEM_3: Getting to know the chosen instrument
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_BASE_ITEM_4: Guided listening and sense of rhythm
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_INTER_SUBTITLE: For those who already have the basics
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_INTER_ITEM_4: Introduction to harmony and music theory
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_ADV_ITEM_3: Active participation in the band's performances
ABOUT_SCHOOL.LEVEL_ADV_ITEM_4: Support in preparing for conservatory or exams
